##### Project general facts

Urban Oasis by Missoni is a direct transfer of Miami's vibrant energy to Dubai, designed with the iconic colors and vibes of the Missoni mood. This thirty-eight-floor waterfront masterpiece is situated at the heart of Dubai, directly on the Dubai Canal, just moments from Dubai's most premium lifestyle locations. Featuring exclusive penthouses accessed by private elevators and luxury apartments with unparalleled views of Dubai's most dynamic areas, every detail in a Missoni Home is a detail well crafted, from the grand Missoni-designed entrance to the flawless superior styles characterizing the ambience.

Residents enjoy a lifestyle of sophistication and wellness with a gym overlooking the best views of the canal, featuring best-in-class workouts fit for Dubai elites. The infinity U-shape swimming pool offers the perfect midday retreat, surrounded by green spaces and the new Business Bay Bridge waterfall. Every aspect of Urban Oasis is designed to elevate the living experience, offering exclusive waterfront living with stunning views of the city and canal.

Relax in the comforts of color schemes that help cast away the stresses of the day, with bedroom designs that echo an atmosphere both inspiring and soothing the mind. These exclusive designs are created solely for Urban Oasis. Every penthouse features a closed kitchen designed to enhance both efficiency and privacy, creating the perfect space to create sumptuous meals for family and guests.

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled at the heart of Dubai directly on the Dubai Canal, this exceptional location is just a stone's throw away from Dubai's most premium lifestyle locations. Downtown Dubai, the centre of Dubai, is home to many landmarks and world-famous attractions including the Burj Khalifa, the Dubai Mall, and the Dancing Fountains, making it a hub of activities that keeps the area busy throughout the year.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning and excellent connectivity. Situated along Sheikh Zayed Road and bordering Business Bay, Downtown is well connected to other key commercial and residential areas in the city. It is one of Dubai's best areas for non-drivers and frequent travellers, offering upscale hotels, chic leisure points, and massive shopping centres that make it a sought-after address and "the centre of now."

For those seeking a residence that embodies iconic design, waterfront elegance, and a prime Dubai address, Downtown Dubai delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class attractions, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
